snippet.title: [New rhythm game] HYPNOSYNC Teaser
snippet.description:
HYPNOSYNC is a hypnosis themed rhythm game, made by BASED KICK.
Coming to PC for free in early 2026, with mobile versions coming at a later date!

Steam Page:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2986590/HYPNOSYNC/

X (Twitter) Page:
https://x.com/hypnosync_game
